def: properly, affable, i.e. mild or kind

occurrences.text: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
